pin.meaning: PIN to check against the live household PIN, global.admin.pin, supplied as payload.pin in the envelope on stdin, never argv. The front door consumes flags.exousia.pin before dispatch, so that carrier does not reach this stop.

verified.meaning: True only when the PIN equals the live household PIN. A completed comparison answers ok true with verified true or false; a wrong PIN is a completed comparison.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class when the front door catches an unhandled stop exception.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Why no comparison ran, or none when there is no missing signal.
